about_the_game:
An RPG with lots of humor and challenges. The battles are classic turn-based. The dungeons include puzzles that need to be solved. In particular, the boss fights are demanding and require strategy and tactics. There are plenty of spells, summons, curses, and class-specific abilities. Among them are Solarbrave, Demons, Light-Strucked Ones, Mages, and other classes. Various armors can also be equipped and improved. The world, villages, and dungeons offer many hidden treasures.The story as well as the world of the gods are based on the books of the fantasy world Tunuss.

About the story: The orphan Deffy grows up in a small village and is just about to undergo her light ceremony. In this, she is supposed to be met by the light of the goddess Atta... But when Deffy frees the demon Beffy, the light over her hometown goes out. The High Priest himself banishes her. Soon she learns that only she, the Light Core, can save the world of Tunuss.

A funny and challenging rpg adventure. Classic. Hard, but fair. The playtime of the beta is over 10 hours. The combination of various spells and curses, which for example lower status attributes, as well as the difficulty level, make the game something special.
